description.text: Founders Villageis a San Francisco–based startup community that connects early-stage tech founders with investors, mentors, and partners. At its core, it's a space where founders meet other founders, investors, pitch, share resources, and learn from each other in a focused, close-knit environment.Tech Weekend is our flagship event series — hosted every 6–8 weeks in San Francisco. It brings together 100+ technical founders and 50–75 venture capitalists for three days of 1:1 investor meetings, live pitch competitions, panels on market trends, and private VC dinners.To date, we’ve hosted thousands of founders and welcomed VCs from firms like Khosla Ventures, LG Technology Ventures, Samsung Ventures, General Catalyst and many more. Whether you’re actively raising or looking to surround yourself with the right people — Founders Village exists to accelerate your path forward.InstagramLinkedInTwitter
